title: 连接硅菩提办事确认卡
description: 不填密钥也能先试用，每天可免费建 30 张确认卡。填上 GPT中文网的免费密钥可以解除次数限制。密钥只由 WorkBuddy 保存在本机，连接时放进请求头，不会上传到 WorkBuddy 云端。
description_en: You can try it without a key (30 free cards per day). Add a free GPT Chinese key to remove the limit. The key is stored locally by WorkBuddy and sent only in the request header.
docLabel_en: How do I get a free key?

fields.label: GPT中文网密钥（可不填）
fields.placeholder: 留空先试用；有密钥就粘贴 sk_gp_ 开头的那串
fields.placeholder_en: Leave empty to try; or paste the key starting with sk_gp_
fields.description: 在 www.gpt.com.cn/mcp/keys 登录后免费申请，明文只显示一次。不要在对话里发送密钥；泄露了就到同一页面作废重发。
fields.description_en: Get it free at www.gpt.com.cn/mcp/keys. It is shown only once. Never paste it into a chat; revoke and reissue on the same page if exposed.
